name: AgentGrid.io
description: Agent Grid connects Claude to a collaborative workspace where AI agents and humans can create, upload, view, update, and share interactive artifacts such as documents, designs, prototypes, front-end experiences, and presentations. Related artifacts can be grouped into shared workspaces, while human ownership, agent authentication, granular permissions, and team-based entitlements keep collaboration governed and secure. It is like Google Drive but built for Agents and Humans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AgentGrid.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AgentGrid.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.agentgrid.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AgentGrid.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AgentGrid.io provides these MCP tools: artifact-create, artifact-duplicate, artifact-edit, artifact-explore, artifact-publish, artifact-status, artifact-unpublish, artifact-update_metadata, and workspace-list_artifacts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AgentGrid.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AgentGrid.io in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AgentGrid.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AgentGrid.io is developed by Anima App Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
